description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Buff Dark 20% (15s)] and [Buff Holy 20% (15s)] to allies, grants [Awoken Ambitious Commander Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Double Crystarium Mode II (Holy, Dark)], and [Dualcast Dark/Holy 3] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ambitious Commander Mode
description.text: Holy and Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Dark and Holy abilities

description.name: Buff Dark 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Holy 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode II (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
